about: Station QRs made by E-03 issueStationQr (services/api/src/station-qr.ts at E-03 head 926c577), signed with the RFC 8032 section 7.1 test keys, which are published test vectors and not real keys. TEST 1 is the allowlisted organizer key and TEST 2 is a key off the allowlist. All three were issued at issued_at with the nonce shown. tampered is valid with one payload byte changed: the station ID st-front becomes st-frone. E-03 verifyStationQr gives: valid ok up to issued_at + 60 and expired at issued_at + 61; stranger signer_not_allowlisted; tampered bad_signature.
